description: Produce rigorous, citation-backed research reports — market analyses, literature reviews, competitive landscapes, technical briefs, due-diligence memos, or any "research X and write it up" request. Use when the user asks to research a topic, write a market analysis, compare competitors, summarize the state of a technology or field, produce a literature review, or wants a deep dive into a subject, including phrasings that don't name the domain directly: "what's the landscape for X," "how mature is Y technology," "who are the main players in Z," "write me a brief on W." Also use for a single-fact lookup needing a traceable, dated source. Parallelizes research across subagents so raw search results don't flood the main thread, builds a real citation registry with per-source freshness tracking instead of loose inline links, and runs a mandatory adversarial counter-review pass before any report is done. Never invents a URL, number, or citation — unverifiable claims are marked as such instead.
